item.text: I’ll read `input.json`, check all three-node placements, and apply the selection rules.

item.command:
/bin/zsh -lc "python3 -B -c 'import json,itertools
with open(\"input.json\") as f: d=json.load(f)
nodes=sorted(d[\"nodes\"],key=lambda n:n[\"id\"])
lat={tuple(sorted((x[\"a\"],x[\"b\"]))):x[\"ms\"] for x in d[\"latencies\"]}
feasible=[]
for group in itertools.combinations(nodes,3):
    ids=[n[\"id\"] for n in group]
    cost=sum(n[\"cost\"] for n in group)
    if cost>d[\"budget\"] or any(lat[tuple(sorted((a[\"id\"],b[\"id\"]))) ]>d[\"max_pair_latency\"] for a,b in itertools.combinations(group,2)):
        continue
    weights=[]
    for scenario in d[\"failures\"]:
        remaining=[n for n in group if n[\"site\"] not in scenario[\"sites\"] and n[\"provider\"] not in scenario[\"providers\"]]
        weight=sum(n[\"vote_weight\"] for n in remaining)
        if weight<d[\"quorum\"] or not any(n[\"writable\"] for n in remaining):
            break
        weights.append(weight)
    else:
        feasible.append((ids,cost,min(weights)))
selected=min(feasible,key=lambda x:(x[1],-x[2],x[0]))
print(json.dumps({\"feasible_placements\":[x[0] for x in feasible],\"selected\":selected[0],\"selected_cost\":selected[1],\"selected_min_surviving_weight\":selected[2]},separators=(\",\",\":\")))
print(\"Feasible placement cost and minimum weight:\",json.dumps(feasible,separators=(\",\",\":\")))'"
